summary: Four material revision candidates were recorded without promotion: decompose supernatural norm enforcement by agent/reward/punishment/scale; downweight ancestry as the explanation for sampled Cerny hunting-associated funerary practice; downweight co-burial as a default proxy for close biological kinship; and model conceptual coherence as an explicit competitor to minimally-counterintuitive accounts of supernatural-concept memorability. Magic-function and neurotheology findings were retained as ontology/guardrail pressure only. No verified dating revision or species re-attribution materially changed the focal deep-time graph.
contradictions_detail: Moralistic supernatural explanation is not reducible to high-god punishment; agent type, reward, punishment, moral content and social scale require separate coding.
Distinctive Cerny hunting-associated funerary practice does not map cleanly to elevated Mesolithic hunter-gatherer biological ancestry in the sampled individuals.
Collective/co-burial does not reliably imply close biological kinship in the sampled early-Christian Swedish cemeteries.
Supernatural-concept memorability is not uniquely explained by ontological violations; conceptual coherence is a directly tested competing mechanism.
Magical/supernatural ideas or practices do not by themselves establish psychopathology or neurodivergent identity; retrospective historical diagnosis remains prohibited.
Cross-regional technological similarity and material composition/presence do not uniquely establish diffusion, authorship, or symbolic motive.

revision_candidates.reason: New 114-society evidence shows moralistic explanations across social scales and heterogeneous agent classes; scale association is stronger for reward than punishment.
Genome-wide data from the sampled Cerny individuals do not show unusually elevated Mesolithic hunter-gatherer ancestry despite hunting-associated funerary traits.

Early-Christian Swedish co-burials often pair children and adults without close biological relatedness; biological kinship, social kinship, community membership and burial proximity must remain separate.
Experimental work supports conceptual coherence as a competitor to minimally-counterintuitive ontological-violation accounts of memorability.

no_change_statement: No approved claim was edited; no speculative relationship was promoted; no graph relationship was generated automatically; no verified revised dating or species re-attribution materially changed the focal deep-time evidence; and D-PLACE focal years remain observation metadata only.
